snippet.title: Neural Nutshell
snippet.description:
Hi, my name is Jamin, and welcome to my channel, Neural Nutshell. I have a background in computer science, but more importantly, I've spent years studying artificial intelligence out of genuine concern. 

I run this channel personally. I write the scripts, add my own commentary, and work closely on the editing to turn videos into clear, original analysis. I have one goal for this channel: make you think. 

On this channel, I break down the ideas and frameworks of thinkers like Geoffrey Hinton, Eliezer Yudkowsky, and Stuart Russell, then compare what they say to what is unfolding in real time. We look at frontier model capabilities, alignment failures, lab race dynamics, economic disruption, and existential risk through the lens of incentives, constraints, and trajectory. 

The goal here is not to push an agenda, but to think clearly about where things may be heading next, while there is still time to think at all.

snippet.title: GaryVee
snippet.description:
Gary Vaynerchuk is a serial entrepreneur and serves as the Chairman of VaynerX, the CEO of VaynerMedia, and the Creator and CEO of VeeFriends. Gary is considered one of the leading global minds on what’s next in culture, relevance, and the internet. Known as “GaryVee,” he is described as one of the most forward thinkers in business. He is a prolific angel investor with early investments in companies like Facebook, Twitter, Tumblr, Venmo, Snapchat, Coinbase, and Uber.

In addition to running multiple businesses, Gary documents his daily life as a CEO through his social media channels, which have more than 45 million followers and garner over 300 million monthly impressions/views across all platforms. Gary serves on the board of MikMak, Bojangles Restaurants, Global Citizen Forum, and Pencils of Promise. He is also a longtime Well Member of charity: water.

snippet.title: Tony Robbins
snippet.description:
Tony Robbins is a #1 New York Times best-selling author, entrepreneur, philanthropist, and the #1 Life and Business Strategist. More than 100 million people from 195 countries have enjoyed the warmth, humor, and transformational power of his business and personal development events. 

He is the author of 7 internationally bestselling books, including three #1 New York Times bestsellers: Money: Master the Game, Unshakeable, and Life Force.  He created the #1 personal and professional development program and more than 10 million people have attended his live seminars.
 
As a philanthropist through the Tony Robbins Foundation and in partnership with Feeding America, Mr. Robbins has provided over 985 million meals to those in need, provides fresh water to 250,000 people a day in India, has awarded 2,500+ grants to health & human services organizations, and supported 1,700+ correctional facilities and thousands of young leaders through teen programs.

Learn more: https://tonyrobbins.com

snippet.title: AI In Context
snippet.description:
AI is now everyone's problem. Let me catch you up.

I'm Aric. AI is fast-moving, confusing, and suddenly everywhere. It's tempting to tune out of the discussion, but I think it's never been more important to tune in. I want to share with you what I've learned about what's ahead: the upsides, the risks, and why we can't afford to put off thinking about them.

This show is produced by 80,000 Hours, a nonprofit that helps people figure out how to use their time to make the transition to a world with AGI go well.

snippet.title: Deloitte Deutschland
snippet.description:
Als eine der weltweit führenden Professional Services Firms bieten wir weit mehr als nur klassische Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen. In interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams verknüpfen unsere rund 14.000 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland ihre Expertise aus den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory und entwickeln mit höchstem Anspruch innovative Lösungen mit echter Wirkung. Verschiedene Perspektiven, Verantwortung und ein starkes „Wir“ durch ein Miteinander auf Augenhöhe machen den Unterschied. So schaffen wir größtmöglichen Impact für Unternehmen, Institutionen, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft – und für dich. 

Ganz gleich, welche Kenntnisse du mitbringst: Bei uns übernimmst du echte Verantwortung. Dabei unterstützen wir dich ab Tag eins durch Mentoring, Feedback und Trainings – denn wir glauben an „The Power of We“: das Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas Großes zu schaffen.

Mehr zu Deloitte Deutschland: https://www.deloitte.com/de/de.html
